parameters.content:
## VIEWING SCHEDULER

PART 1: BOOKING (top flow)
- Calendly webhook captures bookings
- Creates Google Calendar event
- Updates lead sheet
- Sends confirmation to lead + agent

PART 2: REMINDERS (bottom flow)
- Runs every 6 hours
- Checks upcoming viewings
- Sends SMS reminders:
  - 24 hours before
  - 2 hours before

Reduces no-shows from 30% to 10%!
